what: get_call_run asked for a run that does not exist
source: observed against the live MCP endpoint in August 2026 Identifiers, phone numbers and spoken names are synthetic; the shape and every field that carries a finding are as observed.
unobserved: the JSON-RPC envelope around this payload was never captured, only the payload itself; the transcribed result object was elided, so fields beyond the three below may exist
why_it_matters: the provider reports this failure inside an HTTP 200 with no JSON-RPC error key, so a parser that only looks for an error envelope reads it as a successful run and gets an empty one
